title: Grade 7 Term 2 Original Practice Questions — Batch 01
contentStatus: development batch; 90 original questions across nine learning areas; not a complete term bank; IRE is withheld pending an IRE-specific 2027 scheme source
sourceBasis: Original JSLH questions written against Term 2 topic strands surfaced in the user's Grade 7 2027 schemes of work. They are not copied from examination papers. The available scheme collection covers nine learning areas; IRE-specific Term 2 topics require its own scheme before authoring.

subjects.name: Agriculture & Nutrition
mcq: Which observation best shows that a growing crop needs watering?
Leaves are wilting and the soil is dry
Wilting together with dry soil is a sign of water stress.
Which practice helps conserve irrigation water?
Watering at midday in strong sun
Applying water near the plant roots
Targeted watering near roots reduces wastage.
Which record helps a farmer know how much feed livestock consume?
A feeding record tracks the type and amount of feed given.
A suitable livestock house should be:
Dry, secure, ventilated housing supports animal welfare.
Why should a farmer record farm inputs and outputs?
To plan and assess farm performance
Records help track costs, production and decisions.
structured: State four routine practices used to maintain a growing crop.
Award 1 mark each: watering as required; weeding; mulching; thinning; staking; pest/disease monitoring; applying appropriate manure/fertiliser.
Give three ways a farmer can conserve water when irrigating crops.
Any three, 1 mark each: drip irrigation; watering near roots; irrigating in cool hours; mulching; repairing leaks; harvesting rainwater; using watering cans carefully.
Name four basic needs of a healthy farm animal.
Any four: adequate feed; clean water; suitable shelter; space; hygiene; veterinary care; protection from injury and stress.
Explain two reasons for keeping livestock housing clean.
1 mark each explanation: reduces disease and parasite spread; improves animal comfort; reduces smell/flies; protects feed and water from contamination.
A farmer bought 6 bags of feed at KSh 1,250 each and sold eggs worth KSh 4,800. Calculate the feed cost and state why the farmer should record both figures.
Feed cost = 6 × 1,250 = KSh 7,500 (2); records show expenditure and income and help calculate whether the enterprise is making a profit or loss (2).

subjects.name: Creative Arts & Sports
mcq: Which colour relationship uses colours opposite each other on the colour wheel?
Complementary colours are opposite on the colour wheel.
Visual weight is arranged in a stable way
Every object is placed on one side
Balance distributes visual weight to create stability.
Which action improves safety before a sports activity?
Checking the space and warming up
Checking the area and warming up reduce avoidable injuries.
In a team game, a player should pass to a teammate who:
Is closely marked with no space
Is in a useful position to receive
Has turned away and cannot see
A useful passing option is available and able to receive the ball.
A tint is made by adding:
structured: Explain the difference between a tint and a shade, giving one example of each.
Tint: a colour lightened by adding white (1); shade: a colour darkened by adding black (1); suitable examples (1 each).
State four principles a learner should consider when designing a clear poster.
Any four: balance; contrast; emphasis; unity; proportion; readable lettering; appropriate colour; clear layout; suitable image-text relationship.
Give four safety checks to make before a ball game.
Any four: inspect playing surface; check equipment; remove obstacles; wear suitable footwear/clothing; warm up; ensure adequate space; follow rules.
Describe three ways a player can support effective teamwork during a game.
Any three explained: communicate; move into space; pass accurately; follow rules; encourage teammates; defend responsibly; share play.
A team scores 18 goals in 6 matches. Calculate its average goals per match and explain what the average represents.
18 ÷ 6 = 3 goals (2); the team scored an average of 3 goals per match (1).

subjects.name: CRE
mcq: Which action best demonstrates forgiveness after a disagreement?
Accepting an apology and seeking peace
Forgiveness involves letting go of resentment and seeking reconciliation.
A parable is mainly used to:
Teach a moral or spiritual lesson through a story
Parables communicate lessons through familiar stories.
Which action shows responsible use of social media?
Checking information helps prevent spreading false or harmful content.
Which is an example of the Church serving the community?
Churches may contribute through education, health and community support.
A healthy family relationship is strengthened by:
Respectful communication supports trust and understanding.
structured: Give four ways a learner can promote peace in school.
Any four: listen respectfully; resolve disagreements calmly; avoid bullying; forgive; report serious harm to a trusted adult; cooperate; respect differences.
Explain two lessons Christians may learn from a parable.
Award up to 2 marks each for a clearly explained moral/spiritual lesson linked to a parable, such as compassion, honesty, forgiveness, humility or care for others.
State four guidelines for responsible use of social media.

Any four: protect passwords; avoid sharing personal details; verify information; use respectful language; report harmful content; seek adult help; limit screen time; do not meet online strangers alone.
Describe three ways a church can contribute to education or health in a community.
Any three explained: establish/support schools; provide scholarships; health education; clinics/medical outreach; counselling; support vulnerable families.
A learner has offended a friend. Outline four steps the learner could take to restore the relationship.
Any four appropriate steps: acknowledge wrongdoing; apologise sincerely; listen to the friend; make amends; forgive; agree on respectful behaviour; avoid repeating the offence.

subjects.name: English
mcq: Which word is a noun in the sentence 'The careful learner completed the task'?
Learner names a person and functions as a noun.
Choose the correct verb: 'Yesterday, Amina ___ the story.'
The past tense of read is written read.
Which sentence uses a comparative adjective correctly?
This bag is heavier than that one.
This bag is more heavy than that one.
This bag is heaviest than that one.
Heavier is the comparative form of heavy.
The main idea of a paragraph is:
The central point the paragraph communicates
The main idea expresses the paragraph's central message.
Which punctuation mark ends a direct question?
A question mark ends a direct question.
structured: Rewrite in the past tense: 'The pupils carry their books and arrange the desks.'
The pupils carried their books and arranged the desks. Award 1 mark for each correct verb.
Write a paragraph of 5–6 sentences explaining how learners can keep their school safe. Include a topic sentence and at least three supporting ideas.
Award: relevant topic sentence (1); at least three relevant supporting ideas (3); logical sequence/cohesion (1); correct grammar and punctuation (1).
Identify the nouns and verbs in: 'The class captain organised the meeting and invited the teacher.'
Nouns: class/captain, meeting, teacher (any 2–3, 1 mark); verbs: organised, invited (2 marks).
Give the comparative and superlative forms of: bright, careful and good.
bright – brighter – brightest; careful – more careful – most careful; good – better – best. Award 1 mark per correct set.
Read: 'Heavy rain filled the school gutters. Learners removed leaves and plastic so that water could flow freely.' State the problem and two actions taken.
Problem: gutters were blocked/filling with rainwater (1); actions: removed leaves (1) and plastic (1).

subjects.name: Integrated Science
mcq: Which form of energy is stored in a stretched spring?
A stretched spring stores elastic potential energy.
Heat transfer through a metal spoon placed in hot tea mainly occurs by:
Conduction transfers heat through direct particle interactions in a solid.
Which force opposes motion between two surfaces in contact?
Friction acts against relative motion between surfaces.
Which action helps keep drinking water safe?
Storing it in an open dirty container
Storing it in a clean covered container
A clean covered container helps prevent contamination.
Which body system transports oxygen and nutrients around the body?
Blood in the circulatory system transports oxygen and nutrients.
structured: Name four forms of energy and give one example of each.
Any four correctly matched: heat—hot stove; light—Sun/lamp; sound—drum; electrical—fan; chemical—food/battery; kinetic—moving bicycle; potential—raised object/spring. 1 mark each.
Describe an investigation to compare how quickly heat travels through a metal spoon and a wooden stick. Include one safety precaution.

Place equal lengths/material samples with one end in warm water; observe/compare warming at equal distances or use wax markers (2); keep conditions similar and record observations (1); handle hot water with teacher supervision/use tongs (1).
State three effects a force can have on an object and give an example of one effect.
Any three effects: start/stop motion; change speed; change direction; change shape; example linked correctly (1).
Give four ways of protecting a local water source from pollution.
Any four: dispose waste properly; keep chemicals away; maintain sanitation; protect riverbanks; avoid washing near source; treat wastewater; prevent livestock access where necessary.
A learner pushes a box but it does not move. Explain the role of friction and state one way to make the box easier to move.
Static friction balances the applied push up to its limiting value (2); reduce friction using rollers/lubrication or reduce load/increase applied force safely (1).

subjects.name: Kiswahili
mcq: Katika sentensi 'Watoto wanasoma vitabu', neno 'wanasoma' ni:
'Wanasoma' linaonyesha tendo, kwa hivyo ni kitenzi.
Ni alama gani hutumika mwishoni mwa sentensi ya swali?
structured: Tunga sentensi moja kwa kila neno: bidii, mazingira na ushirikiano.
Sentensi tatu zenye matumizi sahihi ya maneno yaliyotolewa. Alama 1 kila sentensi.
Andika wingi wa maneno haya: jicho, ua, mtoto na kikapu.
Macho; maua; watoto; vikapu. Alama 1 kila jibu.
Eleza tofauti kati ya nomino na kitenzi, kisha utoe mfano mmoja wa kila aina.
Nomino hutaja mtu, kitu, mahali au dhana (1); mfano sahihi (1); kitenzi huonyesha tendo au hali (1); mfano sahihi (1).
Andika aya ya sentensi tano kuhusu umuhimu wa kutunza mazingira ya shule.
Maudhui yanayofaa (2); mpangilio na mshikamano (1); sarufi na tahajia (1); aya ina sentensi tano (1).
Tumia alama sahihi za uakifishaji kuandika upya: mama alisema watoto msicheze karibu na barabara
Mama alisema, “Watoto, msicheze karibu na barabara.” Alama za usemi (1), koma/utangulizi (1), herufi kubwa na nukta (1).

subjects.name: Mathematics
mcq: 125° is greater than 90° and less than 180°.
A rectangle is 9 cm long and 4 cm wide. Its perimeter is:
structured: Solve the equation 4y − 7 = 21. Show your working.
A rectangular garden measures 12 m by 7 m. Calculate its perimeter and area.
Convert 3.75 litres into millilitres and 4,600 g into kilograms.
A lesson begins at 8:25 a.m. and ends at 10:05 a.m. Calculate its duration.
1 hour 40 minutes. Correct subtraction/working (2), answer with units (1).
Classify these angles: 45°, 90°, 135° and 180°.
45° acute; 90° right; 135° obtuse; 180° straight. 1 mark each.

subjects.name: Pre-Technical Studies
mcq: Which shape is generally most stable as a simple frame because it resists changing shape?
Triangular bracing helps a frame resist deformation.
A wide base usually makes a structure:
A wider base generally increases stability.
Which tool is most suitable for measuring a length accurately?
A tape measure is designed to measure length.
Which item is personal protective equipment when cutting wood?
Safety goggles protect the eyes from flying particles.
A design brief should clearly state:
The problem, user needs and requirements
Only the colour of the final product
A design brief defines the problem and requirements.
structured: State four factors that affect the stability of a simple structure.
Any four: width of base; height; centre of gravity; mass distribution; strength of joints; material; bracing; shape.
Explain why triangular bracing is used in frames. Give one example of where it may be seen.
Triangle keeps its shape under load and helps prevent racking/deformation (2); example such as roof truss, bridge frame or tower support (1).
List four workshop safety rules to follow when measuring and cutting materials.
Any four: wear goggles; secure workpiece; use correct tool; keep hands clear; measure before cutting; keep workspace tidy; avoid loose clothing; follow instructions.
A learner is designing a simple book stand. Identify three user needs and one test that could be used to evaluate the design.
Any three needs e.g. holds book at readable angle; stable; suitable size; smooth safe edges; durable (3); test by placing a book on it and checking stability/use (1).
Describe the steps for producing a simple design solution from a problem to a finished product.
Identify problem/user (1); research/brief (1); sketch and select design (1); choose materials/tools and plan (1); make safely (1); test/evaluate and improve (1).

subjects.name: Social Studies
mcq: Which physical feature is a raised area of land with a summit?
A mountain is a high raised landform, usually with steep slopes.
A map key is used to:
The key explains symbols used on a map.
Which resource is renewable when managed sustainably?
Which factor may encourage people to settle in a particular area?
Reliable water supports homes, farming and other activities.
The main purpose of a scale on a map is to show:
The relationship between map distance and ground distance
A scale relates measured map distance to actual ground distance.
structured: Name four physical features found in a landscape.
Any four: mountains, hills, valleys, plains, plateaus, rivers, lakes, escarpments, coastal features.
Explain three ways physical features can influence human settlement.
Any three explained: water availability; fertile soils; transport/access; climate; tourism/resources; barriers or hazards; flat land for construction.
A map scale is 1:50,000. What ground distance is represented by 4 cm on the map? Show your working.
Give four ways a community can use natural resources sustainably.
Any four: controlled harvesting; reforestation; soil conservation; water conservation; recycling; regulated fishing/grazing; use renewable energy; protect habitats.
State three effects of poor access to transport on a rural community.
Any three explained: difficulty reaching markets; delayed access to health/education; higher transport costs; limited employment/trade; difficulty moving farm produce.
